annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 14277: Advancing Artificial Intelligence Education for American Youth
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 14277: Advancing Artificial Intelligence Education for American Youth
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order 14277 (April 23, 2025) promotes AI literacy and proficiency in K-12 and workforce education. It creates a White House Task Force on AI Education, a Presidential AI Challenge, public-private partnerships, educator training, and AI apprenticeships. It has no robotics or physical AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the White House Task Force on AI Education, chaired by the OSTP Director
Creates a Presidential Artificial Intelligence Challenge for students and educators
Directs public-private partnerships for K-12 AI literacy resources
Directs Education, NSF and Agriculture to prioritize AI teacher training
Directs Labor to expand AI-related Registered Apprenticeships
